description: Verify that DHCPREQUEST in REBINDING has destination IP = 0xFFFFFFFF (broadcast) (RFC 2131 §4.4.5)
approach:
[Objective]
Mirror of REACQUISITION_02 from the destination angle. RFC 2131 §4.4.5 says the REBINDING REQUEST is broadcast — even if the original server is gone, any DHCP server with knowledge of the binding can pick it up.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND.
2. T1 → RENEWING REQUEST (no ACK).
3. T2 → REBINDING → rebind DHCPREQUEST
   • IPv4 dst_ip == 255.255.255.255   ← key check

[Pass condition]
REBINDING REQUEST's IPv4 dst_ip is the all-ones broadcast.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing OR Fail_rebinding_request_dst_not_broadcast — REQUEST destination is not broadcast.

verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST after ACK
verdicts.Fail_no_rebinding_request: No DUT rebinding DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_rebinding_request_dst_not_broadcast: DUT rebinding REQUEST dst_ip is not broadcast
